title: The Fake Futurism of Elon Musk
summary: A video essay by Tom Nicholas critiquing Elon Musk's futurism, covering SpaceX's Mars plans, Tesla versus Ford and the idea of a slow cancellation of the future. It asks whom Musk's vision of the future serves.
why: Cited in Musk-related threads as a critical perspective on his futurism and his projects, such as hyperloop.

quote.text: There was an interesting critique of Musks futurism by Tom Nicholas. It definitely gave me another perspective.
